rust.kotlin/CallRust.kt:
import java.lang.foreign.Arena
import java.lang.foreign.FunctionDescriptor
import java.lang.foreign.Linker
import java.lang.foreign.MemorySegment
import java.lang.foreign.SymbolLookup
import java.lang.foreign.ValueLayout
import java.nio.file.Path

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val linker = Linker.nativeLinker()
    Arena.ofConfined().use { arena ->
        val rust = SymbolLookup.libraryLookup(Path.of(args[0]), arena)
        val greeting = linker.downcallHandle(
            rust.find("greeting").orElseThrow(),
            FunctionDescriptor.of(ValueLayout.ADDRESS, ValueLayout.ADDRESS))
        val greetingFree = linker.downcallHandle(
            rust.find("greeting_free").orElseThrow(),
            FunctionDescriptor.ofVoid(ValueLayout.ADDRESS))
        val text = greeting.invokeWithArguments(arena.allocateFrom("Kotlin")) as MemorySegment
        println(text.reinterpret(Long.MAX_VALUE).getString(0))
        greetingFree.invokeWithArguments(text)
    }
}

import ctypes
import sys

lib = ctypes.CDLL(sys.argv[1])


class Point(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("x", ctypes.c_double), ("y", ctypes.c_double)]


lib.point_distance.argtypes = [Point, Point]
lib.point_distance.restype = ctypes.c_double
print("distance:", lib.point_distance(Point(0, 0), Point(3, 4)))

lib.greeting.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p]
lib.greeting.restype = ctypes.c_void_p  # keep the address, to give it back to greeting_free
lib.greeting_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
text = lib.greeting(b"Python")
print(ctypes.string_at(text).decode())
lib.greeting_free(text)
